plan.title: Add a thin policy index and human-approved violation reduction

criteria.description: Policy index rejects missing rule configuration, invalid source references, unsafe paths and unbound fixtures.
Only complete per-rule findings are classified; invalid or incomplete output cannot appear resolved.
Explicit bootstrap establishes known findings; approved reduction is shrink-only and removed findings become new if reintroduced.
Normal source fixes remain comparable while changed definitions, scope, inputs, candidate or baseline reject stale approval.
Failure, cancellation and concurrent publication preserve the approved baseline and never manufacture reduction.
Bound rule fixtures execute the selected adapter and distinguish expected violations from errors or unavailable environments.
Policy commands report deterministic states and exit codes and require explicit terminal review without changing contract baselines.

limitations: One policy index and one configured findings surface per repository; trusted local adapters supply complete per-rule results.
Explicit initial bootstrap and subsequent shrink-only approval; no automated definition migration, reset, waiver or growth approval.
Review identity is self-reported; same-user file tampering and dishonest adapter completeness are outside the trust boundary.
No new lint language, dependencies, tool installation, remote execution or implicit integration with Stop/pre-push modes.
Minimum Go and other OS runtimes are only claimed when actually executed; cross-vet is static evidence.
